body:
Concurrent dependency additions must survive integration without textual lockfile merging.

- [ ] For Cargo, npm and uv fixtures, merge independent manifest additions, start from trunk lockfile, regenerate in a validator and pass the ecosystem gate.
- [ ] Confirm both dependencies survive; record available cache/offline assumptions, deterministic output, failure and timeout behavior.
- [ ] Bind successful evidence to the final regenerated tree, not the pre-regeneration candidate. Trusted trunk rule/command cannot be replaced by candidate config.
- [ ] Commit scripts and short go/no-go report. Qualification covers these ecosystems; shipping example defaults remain a maintainer decision.
title: S6: Qualify lockfile regeneration for Cargo, npm and uv
